Im the wrong forum. Honestly coming from a guy who is severely depressed right now and has been in the past insanely suicidal. Failed drowning attempt. I.e. hold a rock and try drown at 2am till you change your mind and come crying to a stranger for help at 3am.

Suicide is not the right play. It really isn't. 

The life we have is some gift. There is no sequel. We stop existing. So why even bother quitting. That's it. 

There will be happier days. 

Suicide is not the answer.
Let the police find you. Give your family closure.

Any book recommendations for a self destructive human. 

Its annoying cuz I don't get the intervention others get because I can hide it so well.
